engineeringSkip.reason: Zero-point energy harvesting is pseudo-science: the quantum vacuum's ground state is by definition the lowest-energy state, and the Casimir effect produces no net energy gain, so no device can extract power from it.

factCheck.reason: The quantum vacuum is the lowest-energy state of a system, so no device can extract net energy from it — the Casimir effect produces a tiny force, not a power source.
